x: As for the Juniors, we have a number of very promising lads. Dennis Fleming, Peter Drew and Arthur Allen in the Shot.
Dick Negus could only manage a couple of second places in the Jumps but was up against stronger opposition this time. A.
Arthur Bruce won the 1 Mile, and although the S.L.H. boys won the Relay, we picked up some useful points in the Field Events through the help of Alan Dunn, Dennis Fleming and A.
We had a return match with the Cambridge lads at Tooting on June 11th, and sadly missed Alan Sexton, who was running for his school. Our only winner was A.
Arthur Allen has, however, taken his place as our best Junior Javelin thrower, and he is to be congratulated on gaining a standard in the Senior Club Championship.
Arthur Allen, now in the Artillery, sends greetings from Plymouth where he is keeping fit as a P.T.

However, it is to Alan Dunn, Geoff Jarvis, Arthur Allen and Terry Bateman we look for improved performances and from at least one, distances approaching, even if not beating those achieved by the old stalwarts in previous years.

We shall also be glad to welcome back to the fold Arthur Allen who has now finished his Army service. He was a promising Javelin thrower as a Junior and now having reached Senior status, we hope he will prove himself to be one of our best.
Maclean ran well to finish fourth in such company. A.
We hope Bergvalds will get better support and look to Arthur Allen and Dennis Childs for this, as we cannot expect Bill Sutton to go on for ever.
